reviews.text: Best Petshop in the area, very friendly and helpful  staff who are always willing to give customers the best advice regarding their pets
Amazing pet shop with all your pet's needs covered staff are very friendly and incredibly knowledgeable and will try their best to help!
Friendly and helpful staff and lots of natural treats to choose from!
Great selection of produce for dogs and friendly staff.
Really disappointed with this store recently. The price of things compared to competitors is honestly silly. I won’t be back and will be taking my business to Maxi Zoo up the road from now on.
Everything you need for the favourite family member.
Sarah was so so helpful 🌟 thank you …

Honestly wasn't impressed...staff just stood at the register on their phones and chatting amongst themselves completely ignoring customers. Kind of frustrating when you can clearly tell a potential shopper needs help. Asked a couple of questions to which I got a "yes" or "no" answer...no offer of other products or alternative...they just didn't care which means I'm not going back because my newly adopted dog is my world. Spend your money elsewhere honestly.
Friendly staff and good value to be had!
Staff here are always very friendly and provide helpful advice. This is uncommon in todays world! They should be very proud of the work they do.
Cat food selection is always so small and disappointing — just 1 wet food option for kittens! While dogs have shelves and shelves of all variety food. :(

I went here yesterday looking for a big cage for my hamster and was talking to a lovely girl told me lots of facts about hamsters that I didn't know and what would and wouldn't be suitable for her, I was surprised as I thought they would only really know about cats and dogs but no, really knowledgeable and helpful, thanks so much

Great service! Lynsey was very heplful and knowledgeable. I just got a new puppy and she helped me pick everything I need. She is very kind and patient.I will definitely come back for her advice! Best wishes from Mia&Marla🐶 …

Staff are very good and go out of their way to help but the product range has dwindled significantly over the last few years. More or less only geared toward dogs and cats now. Reptile products are at a fraction of what they used to be and live food availability is poor. Most weeks only two or three main types and often already dying off by the weekend.

The few remaining reptile products, pricing is really steep. A like-for-like lighting system at Urban Exotics in Ballymount is 1/3 of the price. Owner there said he makes 20% on that stuff so Petworld must be absolutely gouging their customers.

Live food pricing is 'okay' but doesn't last long at all and you'll get double the quantity for the same price in places like Urban Exotics.
Super store and staff
Male ginger employee was amazing help
Always a pleasure going there as the staff is super helpful.

I went this week to buy things for my hamster and what I found in the story horrified me.*FISHES IN TERRIBLE CONDITIONS* (tiny cages and lack of enrichment), insects and worms that are considered food for reptiles in really bad conditions as well *IN A TINY TOP,SHARING WITH MANY OTHER INSECTS*, and they sell hamsters balls that is absolutely terrible for hamsters, and worse..the cages that they sell it’s too small for the hamster…cages are required to be 100x50 “animal welfare laws require that pets be kept in environments that meet their physical and behavioral needs. Providing a cage that is too small could be considered neglectful under these laws”…so I bought mealworms,treats and chew toys for my hamster, the woman  lacked  knowledge because she was asking what type of pet I had because I was buying mealworms for my hamster, hamsters are omnivorous, which means they eat both plant and animal-based foods.
In the wild, their diet includes:
•	Seeds and grains
•	Fruits and vegetables
•	Insects (like mealworms or crickets)
•	Occasionally small bits of meat
She said she has never seen it before and that actually really worried me, because i knew more than the staff there…
I left this shop horrified….
Staff are super nice, especially girl at front desk. My dog drags me there as often as he can!
Friendly helpful Staff thank you

Staff couldn’t have been more helpful, got a wonderful bed for my large dog. He normally won’t use them but has taken to this straight away after trying it out with some treats in the store. Was a success from the get go, thanks to the pet world staff.
Thanks for the 5 star review Vanessa
Staff always super friendly and helpful with adults, kids and the pets themselves.

I wanted to share my experience at the store while looking for new puppy stuff with my daughter.  Sarah from your staff was incredibly helpful. She assisted us in choosing the right cage and bed for our new pet, and her knowledge about dogs was impressive. The customer service was excellent, and all the information she provided was incredibly useful. This was our first visit to your store, and I am definitely planning to return. We are very happy with the service we received.
Nice pet shop very helpful staff
Went here constantly for one of their frequent buyer offers only for them to wipe everything on their system and not honor the loyalty scheme. Don't trust their offers.
We had a great experience in Petworld Nutgrove recently when we bought our fish & starter tank. The staff provided great advice on setting up the tank & how to look after the fish. 5* experience

Went recently here and I had no idea what to buy or knew much about the reptile I was getting, until I met Louis, who answered all our questions with ease and gave fantastic advice and safety tips. Thanks Louis
It is a very complete store, there is everything for different types of pets.
Expensive
